name: bruin-agent-resource-kit
description: Example agent skills for working with a startup's data through Bruin. Sample code, provided as-is; not a supported Bruin product.

plugins.name: bruin-agent
plugins.description: Install the Bruin CLI, create a project, choose a template, connect a source and register the Bruin MCP server.

plugins.name: startup-data-kit
plugins.description: Set up a Bruin template for a startup's data and answer questions from it: revenue, marketing, product, web, AI search, finance, support, AI coding spend, sheets and Notion.

plugins.name: data-engineering-skills
plugins.description: Keep Bruin pipelines healthy: triage failures, investigate anomalies, backfill safely, open maintenance pull requests, report what happened.

plugins.name: coding-agent-workflows
plugins.description: Repeatable work on a codebase: customer-facing changelogs and recorded terminal demos.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: Sample scripts an agent can shell out to, run with your own credentials: Attio CRM, blog cover images, LinkedIn enrichment via Apify.
